description:
Pluto Station Builder
Bring the Domain's industrial might back to life.

Early Beta — publishing for initial testing. Feedback welcome.

What is this?

A Starsector 0.98a-RC8 mod that lets you build the Pluto Mining Station from Ashes of the Domain in any lava-type colony and control it — switch between peaceful mining and combat lockdown from an industry dialog. No AoTD files touched. No reflection. No patches.

Features

• Build the station — a new Pluto Station Construction industry spawns the megastructure in orbit, restores all sections, and removes itself.
• Combat Mode — the station rotates toward the nearest hostile fleet and cuts it apart with a red laser. Fleet CR drains; at zero the fleet dies.
• Mining Mode — the station rotates back to the planet and resumes AoTD mining.
• Line-of-sight — fleets behind planets are ignored, the station picks the next clean target.
• Persistent state — mode is saved and restored after reload.
• Zero conflicts — works on top of AoTD using only its official API.

Requirements

Starsector 0.98a-RC8, Ashes of the Domain — Vaults of Knowledge, LazyLib, Ashlib.

Install

Drop PlutoStation into Starsector/mods/, enable in launcher, start a new game or load an existing save.

Download

Pluto Station Builder — Early Beta (Google Drive)

Known limitations (beta)

• Only works with the Pluto station.
• AoTD window-glow sprite is temporarily hidden in combat mode.
• Planets block shots on purpose.
• Edge cases are possible — please report.

Reporting bugs

Send starsector.log with lines matching [PlutoStation/Combat], [PlutoStation/Beam], or [PlutoStation/Builder], plus a short description.

Credits

kaysaar — author of Ashes of the Domain, whose Pluto megastructure is the entire foundation of this mod. Thanks for permission to publish.

License

Published with permission of AoTD author. Do not redistribute AoTD assets as part of this mod.
